detail.longDescription: Colorado Sun: New evidence shows Boulder climate lab was dismantled in act of political reprisal, lawsuit alleges. “New evidence shows overt political retaliation against Colorado is behind the Trump administration’s dismantling of the National Center for Atmospheric Research lab in Boulder, according to new filings in a lawsuit by the lab’s university consortium managers.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/09/09/colorado-sun-new-evidence-shows-boulder-climate-lab-was-dismantled-in-act-of-political-reprisal-lawsuit-alleges/
